fieldValues.title: 5. Allocate: what we tried and where we went too far
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
The ideal: Ready work reaches the right hands, human or agent, at the right time, and nothing is claimed twice or dropped.

What we have tried: wg labels and lane:unattended; topup and promote; clerk claim with seats and mandates; stale-claims; working groups with charters; routines; decision f301ae06 (local sessions act as group members); sequences for multi-step work.

Problems recorded here: SP-59, SP-31, SP-50, SP-70, SP-62.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Line 1, Hold until ready and let it flow: too far toward Hold until ready. The 2026-10 backlog was parked wholesale until domains and problems existed (handbook, How an issue reaches a group).
- Line 2, Many lanes and one queue: too far toward Many lanes. About 80% of merged PRs came from local sessions and 5% from the ready queue (decision f799b6bc).
- Line 3, Self-selection and assignment by rule: too far toward Self-selection. Cited mandates are never checked (SP-70); agents lack a group's rules of engagement (SP-31).
fieldValues.unresolved_questions:
- The three tensions are a first pass: none has its four 2×2 cases or the cube filled yet (handbook, A domain's axes, steps 3 and 4).
- Is each tension orthogonal to the other two in this stage, and which pole is yang here: does it flip from the parent domain?
fieldValues.next_action: Fill the 2×2 cases from the stage's own history; then name the remedy that moves us back out of each shadow.
